[d0407] config | quota.worker_threads (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `quota.worker_threads` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of worker threads used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `8` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | quota |
| Unit | threads |

## Notes

Changes to `quota.worker_threads` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[quota]
worker_threads = 8
```

---

# `broker.worker_threads`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of worker threads used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues.

| Type | integer |
| Default | `4` |

| Component | broker |
| Unit | threads |

## Notes

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml

worker_threads = 4
```

[d0402] config | retention.worker_threads (PaderQueue 2.x) | version 2.x
# `retention.worker_threads` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Number of worker threads used by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1` |
| Available since | 1.0 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | threads |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `retention.worker_threads` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
worker_threads = 1
```
